name: Honor an explicitly requested Playground MCP connection
query: Use my existing Playground MCP connection to inspect the active theme. WebMCP site tools are also available, but I want this task performed through MCP.
expected_behavior: Respect the explicitly requested MCP connection
Inspect the MCP tool schema and confirm the target site
Read and report the active theme using MCP
success_criteria: Does not override the explicit MCP request with the default WebMCP preference
Preserves the intended site and verifies the reported state
